selection_reasoning: The oak_trapdoor will be placed as a door/barrier blocking access to a room containing cobblestone blocks needed for furnace crafting. The player must first mine (break) the oak_trapdoor to gain access to the cobblestone, then mine 8 cobblestone, and finally craft them into a furnace using a nearby crafting table. This creates a natural physical dependency: the trapdoor gates access to the crafting resources. Both tasks are observable and verifiable — the trapdoor disappears from the world, and the furnace appears in inventory.

The player starts with no oak_trapdoor in inventory, so its presence confirms the block was mined. Two oak trapdoors are stacked in the doorway at spawn-relative (1, 1, 6) and (1, 2, 6); mining at least one satisfies the task and grants access to the room. Uses inventory_has because crafting a furnace from 8 cobblestone on the crafting table results in a furnace item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with no furnace in inventory and there is no other furnace source in the scene, so its presence definitively confirms successful crafting. The player must first mine at least 8 of the 14 available cobblestone blocks inside the room using the provided wooden pickaxe, then use the crafting table at spawn-relative (3, 1, 7). Preferred rule type #1 for craft tasks.

scene_description: A stone brick room on a flat grass area, approximately 6 blocks from spawn. The room contains 14 cobblestone blocks and a crafting table. The only entrance is a 1-block-wide doorway blocked by two stacked oak trapdoors (at y+1 and y+2), creating a physical barrier. The player spawns outside with a wooden pickaxe and must mine through the trapdoors to access the cobblestone and crafting table needed to craft a furnace.
task_text: Mine the oak trapdoor blocking the doorway to enter the stone brick room, then mine cobblestone inside and craft a furnace using the crafting table.
design_notes: Room is 9x6 interior (from ~-2 to ~4 x, ~7 to ~10 z). Walls are 4 blocks tall (y+1 to y+4). Doorway at ~(1, 1-3, 6) is 1 block wide, 3 blocks tall but blocked by 2 stacked trapdoors at y+1 and y+2. The 14 cobblestone blocks are placed along the back walls (z=9-10) at floor level. Crafting table is at ~(3,1,7) just inside the room on the right. Player spawns ~6 blocks from the front wall on flat grass. The area is cleared of trees/natural terrain to ensure clear visibility and approach.
